mapper.sql: entry_id AS entryId, list_id AS listId, subject_type AS subjectType, subject_key AS subjectKey, source_type AS sourceType, source_effect_id AS sourceEffectId, reason, created_by AS createdBy, deactivated_by AS deactivatedBy, deactivated_reason AS deactivatedReason, status, active_slot AS activeSlot, effective_from AS effectiveFrom, effective_to AS effectiveTo, supersedes_entry_id AS supersedesEntryId, version, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_risk_list_entry(entry_id, list_id, subject_type, subject_key, source_type, source_effect_id, reason, created_by, deactivated_by, deactivated_reason, status, active_slot, effective_from, effective_to, supersedes_entry_id, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{row.entryId}, #{row.listId}, #{row.subjectType}, #{row.subjectKey}, #{row.sourceType}, #{row.sourceEffectId}, #{row.reason}, #{row.createdBy}, #{row.deactivatedBy}, #{row.deactivatedReason}, #{row.status}, #{row.activeSlot}, #{row.effectiveFrom}, #{row.effectiveTo}, #{row.supersedesEntryId}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_risk_list_entry WHERE list_id = #{listId} AND subject_type = #{subjectType} AND subject_key = #{subjectKey} AND active_slot = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_risk_list_entry SET status = #{status}, active_slot = NULL, deactivated_by = #{deactivatedBy}, deactivated_reason = #{deactivatedReason}, effective_to = #{effectiveTo}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE entry_id = #{row.entryId} AND version = #{row.version} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_risk_list_entry ORDER BY create_time DESC, entry_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
